title: Agents - fix discard changes for added files
body:
This pull request addresses a bug in the Agents window where the "Discard Changes" action did not work for added files. The changes made include:

- Updated the `agentHostDiscardChangesOperationHandler.ts` to check for untracked files and use the local Node-side trash capability when available, ensuring that added files are moved to the trash/recycle bin instead of being permanently deleted.
- Removed unnecessary reverse client RPC plumbing, simplifying the implementation to directly utilize the `IFileService.del` method with the `useTrash` option.
- Added focused unit tests to cover scenarios for tracked files, untracked files with trash support, and untracked files without trash support.
- Re-enabled the existing conformance test for untracked files and removed its known-issue entry.

Validation steps were performed, including type checks and transpilation, with all checks passing except for Electron-based tests, which were blocked by sandbox policy.
